Maya (CSM): Heads-up — AtlasForge showed a 48% drop in /batch-generate calls since Tuesday. New procurement eval vs CompetitorY apparently around pricing per 1k tokens. Need quick triage before their shortlist call. :mag_right:
Ethan (AM): When's the shortlist call?
Maya (CSM): Friday 10am client local. They're trying to cut unit cost for nightly invoice generation. Link to usage: https://redwood.dash/atlasforge/usage — sample:
```
This week: avg-per-job tokens 18.2k -> 11.1k
Nightly jobs: 8k -> 4.1k
Top route cost share: /batch-generate 78%
```
Priya (SRE): No uptick in errors or latency that'd explain drop. Logs show retries down (fewer jobs), not failures.
Maya (CSM): Client PM Sofia asked about model+pricing alternatives. She mentioned CompetitorY has a smaller-context model that's cheaper per token for their batched flows.
Zoe (RevOps): I can run a price comparison + show impact of our bulk-caching + larger batching profile. If we can demonstrate ~25% TCO reduction using reserved burst + 8k batch window that could be convincing. I have results by 1:30pm PT.
Ethan (AM): Priya / Maya — can we offer a short proof window: 2-week reserved pool w/ guaranteed throughput and usage reporting? That might beat a naive competitor shortlist.
Priya (SRE): Technically yes. We can spin a small dedicated pool and enable prefix cache for their job templates. Need SOX check? (jk) :grin:
Maya (CSM): I'll ask Sofia for the exact repro payloads and the acceptance criteria they care about (cost per invoice, latency SLA).
deploy-bot: [canary] provisioned reserved-pool atlasforge-pool-2024-08-14 by priya at 2024-08-14T18:02:11Z
Zoe (RevOps): Attached cost delta snapshot (rough): our baseline $0.035/token -> optimized $0.026/token (~26% lower) vs CompetitorY quoted $0.021/token but with caveats (no KV cache, no streaming). I'll post a clean CSV in the drive.
Ethan (AM): Good. Two asks before the Friday call: 1) Maya — get Sofia's acceptance criteria. 2) Priya — run a 48-hour canary with reserved pool and two payloads (small-batch, large-batch) and capture token-per-job and latency. 3) Zoe — prepare exec one-pager with TCO and feature tradeoffs.
Maya (CSM): On it. I'll ping Sofia now and CC AM + SRE.
Priya (SRE): Starting canary now. Quick note: enabling aggressive batching may increase tail latency for interactive flows; I'll mark that in risks.
Maya (CSM): Also proposing a promotional term: 2-week trial with bundled observability + a credit that offsets ~10% of cost for the first month to remove friction. Ethan, you good owning the offer?
Ethan (AM): Yep. I'll draft terms and send to legal for a fast review.
Maya (CSM): Will update thread after canary results (expect initial metrics in ~8 hours). Thanks team. :rocket:
